cause.description: Free-form cause string; for plan §9 S11 binary observable expects 'vsock_disconnect+kill0_dead' or similar '+'-joined signal list

alive_at_timeout.description: Plan §9 S17 binary observable: slot indices still alive when max_duration_s elapsed. Null when result != 'timeout'.

total_duration_s.description: Plan §9 S17 binary observable: elapsed seconds from HARNESSES_UP to terminal state. Null for pre-match errors (boot/provisioning timeouts).
